# pve_sdn_vnet_firewall (Data Source)

Firewall state scoped to one VNet: options, rule list, and (optionally) a single rule by position.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_sdn_vnet_firewall" "example" {
  vnet = "CHANGE_ME"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vnet` (String) The SDN vnet object identifier.

### Optional

- `pos` (Number) Update rule at position <pos>.

### Read-Only

- `enable` (Boolean) Enable/disable firewall rules.
- `id` (String) Identifier: <vnet>/<pos>.
- `index` (String) Raw JSON payload returned by /cluster/sdn/vnets/{vnet}/firewall (the API schema does not describe its shape).
- `log_level_forward` (String) Log level for forwarded traffic.
- `policy_forward` (String) Forward policy.
- `rule` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rule))
- `rules` (Attributes List) Returned by /cluster/sdn/vnets/{vnet}/firewall/rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) Rule action ('ACCEPT', 'DROP', 'REJECT') or security group name
- `comment` (String) Descriptive comment
- `dest` (String) Restrict packet destination address
- `dport` (String) Restrict TCP/UDP destination port
- `enable` (Number) Flag to enable/disable a rule
- `icmp_type` (String) Specify icmp-type. Only valid if proto equals 'icmp' or 'icmpv6'/'ipv6-icmp'
- `iface` (String) Network interface name. You have to use network configuration key names for VMs and containers
- `ipversion` (Number) IP version (4 or 6) - automatically determined from source/dest addresses
- `log` (String) Log level for firewall rule
- `macro` (String) Use predefined standard macro
- `pos` (Number) Rule position in the ruleset
- `proto` (String) IP protocol. You can use protocol names ('tcp'/'udp') or simple numbers, as defined in '/etc/protocols'
- `source` (String) Restrict packet source address
- `sport` (String) Restrict TCP/UDP source port
- `type` (String) Rule type
